meta.name: trust-calibration
meta.description: Helping users form warranted trust in the AI — neither overtrust nor undertrust — through deliberate confidence and source signalling.

copy.tagline: 校准对AI的信任程度，避免过度或不足
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望理性判断AI输出的可信度
copy.tagline_en: Calibrate your trust in AI to avoid overtrust or undertrust
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to rationally judge the credibility of AI outputs

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude会根据实际知识确定水平，使用“我相当确定”“请核实”等措辞，标注信息来源和替代观点，明确自己不能做什么，并在犯错后主动更正。
howto.when: 当你询问需要一定可信度的信息，例如医疗、金融建议或事实查证，Claude会启动信任校准行为。

say.text: 这个药和我的降压药能一起吃吗？
say.note: Claude会表示无法给出医疗建议，并建议咨询医生或药师。
Claude会提供分析，但强调这是推测，请自己做研究。

say.text: 帮我核实一下这个历史事件的时间。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude calibrates its expressions of confidence based on actual epistemic state, uses phrases like 'I'm fairly sure' or 'I'd verify this', attributes sources, surfaces alternatives, admits errors, and fences capabilities.
howto.when_en: When you ask for information that requires trust calibration, such as medical, financial advice, or factual verification, Claude activates this behavior.

say_en.text: Can I take this medication with my blood pressure pill?
say_en.note: Claude declines medical advice and suggests consulting a doctor or pharmacist.

say_en.text: Is now a good time to buy stocks?
Check the date of this historical event.
